estimates: The museum outline and the pedestrian path to the entrance come from the map. The dataset repeats the same measured outline, so the exact exterior changes and boundary of the 2024 extension are approximate.

The museum confirms a flat entrance with automatic glass doors. Its published design describes an arch that is represented here as estimated. Roof heights, gable and skillion divisions, cladding, and service openings are estimated.

review.notes: The Qualla exterior photo is attribution and share-alike licensed. Its public-domain pit dwelling image depicts the earlier English open-air museum.
